d: Designs, implements, maintains, and supports IT infrastructure across Fakeeh Care entities. Ensures high availability, scalability, security, and performance of systems spanning data centers, cloud platforms, and enterprise networks. Collaborates with cross-functional IT teams to modernize infrastructure and support business operations.
q: Education: Bachelor’s in IT, Computer Science, or related field.
r: li
Infrastructure Management: Designs, deploys, and manages servers, storage, virtualization, and networks (on-premises and cloud).
li
Performance Monitoring: Tracks system performance, capacity, and availability to ensure uptime.
li
Automation & Tools: Implements automation, configuration management, and monitoring solutions.
li
Virtualization: Manages VMware, Hyper-V, or equivalent platforms.
li
Cloud Services: Deploys and manages workloads in Azure, AWS, or GCP with focus on cost efficiency and security.
li
Networking: Configures and troubleshoots LAN/WAN, firewalls, load balancers, VPNs, and routing protocols.
li
Security Collaboration: Works with security teams on patching, access control, and compliance.
li
Backup & Recovery: Implements backup, replication, and disaster recovery procedures.
li
Business Continuity: Participates in continuity planning and execution.
li
Cross-Team Collaboration: Works with applications, DBA, and support teams to deliver reliable IT services.
li
Documentation: Maintains infrastructure documentation, SOPs, and architecture diagrams.
li
Other duties as assigned within the scope of the job.
